Third-party Stata software

ftools and supporting Mata/ado helpers: Sergio Correia.
Source: https://github.com/sergiocorreia/ftools
Bundled header version: 2.50.0, 09 January 2026. MIT license supplied.

reghdfe and supporting/compatibility routines: Sergio Correia.
Source: https://github.com/sergiocorreia/reghdfe
Bundled version: 6.13.1, 10 January 2026. MIT license supplied.

sdid: Daniel Pailanir and Damian Clarke; related event-study implementation
associated with Diego Ciccia.
Sources: https://github.com/Daniel-Pailanir/sdid
         https://github.com/Daniel-Pailanir/sdid/tree/main/sdid_event
GPL license supplied. Exact author-installed source snapshots are preserved;
the sdid header says 2.0.2 but its body supports projected covariates.
Checksums identify the supplied implementation, without upgrading the code.

unique: Michael Hills and Tony Brady. Bundled header: 1.2.4, 17 June 2020.
Distribution: https://ideas.repec.org/c/boc/bocode/s354701.html
Preserved ado/help files and original author notices; consult its distributor
for applicable package-specific reuse terms.

All shipped Mata implementations and source helpers remain with the routines.
No proprietary Stata executable or proprietary Stata library is redistributed.
Package binaries and upstream sources retain their original licenses.
The supplied license texts apply to their named third-party components, not
as a blanket license over source datasets or author manuscript materials.
